description: On the table there’s a small wire basket with a shiny metal tray beside it, and several colorful plastic utensils (spoons, forks, and knives) scattered to the right. The left hand and right hand move in from the bottom and gather a handful of utensils together, then the left hand lifts and holds the metal tray while the right hand places the bundled utensils into it; after that, the right hand reaches to the remaining blue utensils and inserts them into the tray as well while the left hand steadies it as a left-hand object.
